verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of flags, segments, experiments or observability data in open formats. Adjacent items do not count as an export capability: OpenFeature providers that can replace the SDK, read-scoped API tokens, a CLI for managing resources, and running experiments from warehouse data are building blocks or other features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
